title: A Choir for the Cellar
author: Xanthe Dravenmoor
blurb: Casper Zhou, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
